Gravy Momos 🌶️🥟
.
Ingredients:
	•	8–10 steamed momos 
	•	1 medium onion (sliced)
	•	½ capsicum (sliced)
	•	1 tsp oregano
	•	½ tsp chilli flakes
	•	1 tbsp Schezwan sauce
	•	1 tbsp mayonnaise
	•	1 tbsp tomato ketchup
	•	½ cup water (for gravy consistency)
	•	1 tbsp oil
	•	Salt to taste
	•	Fresh coriander (chopped)

Method:
	1.	Prepare Momos
	•	Take steamed momos and deep fry them until golden and crispy. Keep aside.
	2.	Make the Gravy Base
	•	Heat oil in a pan.
	•	Sauté onions and capsicum on high flame for 1–2 minutes until slightly crunchy.
	3.	Add Flavors
	•	Add oregano, chilli flakes, Schezwan sauce, mayonnaise, and tomato ketchup.
	•	Mix well until sauces combine.
	4.	Make Gravy
	•	Add about ½ cup water (adjust as needed) to make a saucy consistency.
	•	Stir well and let it cook for 1–2 minutes.
	5.	Add Momos
	•	Toss in the fried momos and coat them well with the gravy.
	6.	Finish & Serve
	•	Garnish with chopped coriander.
